technique_name: Discuss the importance of proper space management in an office.
description: Proper space management in an office is critical for productivity and efficiency. A well-organized office layout maximizes the use of available space and minimizes congestion. Additionally, it can help create a more inviting space, encourage collaboration among coworkers, enhance the company’s brand, and provide an ergonomic work environment.
